name: Noise Residual
description: Examines high-frequency noise patterns by applying Wiener deconvolution. Real cameras produce characteristic sensor noise that varies across the image, while AI generates unnaturally uniform noise.
mechanism:
The 分析 process:

1. **Noise extraction**: 应用 Wiener deconvolution filter to separate the noise component from image content.

2. **Local 方差 mapping**: Computes local noise 方差 跨 overlapping blocks to create a noise 方差 heatmap.

3. **Uniformity 分析**: Real camera noise varies due to sensor manufacturing imperfections (光响应非均匀性). AI images lack this variation.

4. **Statistical profiling**: 分析 噪声分布 statistics (kurtosis, skewness) against known camera noise models.
parameters:
Filter: Wiener deconvolution, Window: 5x5
块大小: 16x16 with 50% overlap
Noise model: Gaussian + Poisson (heteroscedastic)
Metrics: local 方差, kurtosis, skewness
accuracy: High - 80-90% for distinguishing natural vs synthetic noise
useCase: Detecting absence of authentic sensor noise patterns in AI-generated images

references.title: Chen, M. et al. (2008). Determining Image Origin and Integrity Using Sensor Noise. IEEE TIFS.
Lukas, J., Fridrich, J. & Goljan, M. (2006). Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise. IEEE TIFS.
Cozzolino, D. & Verdoliva, L. (2020). Noiseprint: A CNN-Based Camera Model Fingerprint. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Robust against content 篡改
• Camera-specific noise is extremely difficult to forge
• Works 跨 different image formats
• Can identify specific camera models
limitations:
• Effectiveness reduced by heavy denoising or compression
• Requires sufficient image 分辨率
• Some AI models now add synthetic noise to evade 检测
• Social media compression degrades 噪声模式s
